event.title: SFSCON'26 - 'How to design successful campaigns that scale' in Bolzano, Italy in Bolzano, Italy

body.p: Marta Andreoli will present the evolution of a grassroots educational journey that started within the Free Software Foundation Europe and grew into a community-driven toolkit used in schools across different contexts. The talk will reflect on how community creativity, narrative tools, and structured support materials can work together to scale educational outreach, and how volunteer ecosystems can be empowered through shared ownership of educational content.
The talk will be in English and it will take place in the Seminar 1.
